android.desc:
Tired of blindly accepting privacy policies? Worried about who has your data and what they’re doing with it? It’s time to take back control. ProSe is your personal privacy guardian, transforming the complex world of data protection into a simple, engaging, and even fun experience.

Level Up Your Privacy Game!

ProSe introduces a revolutionary gamified approach to digital safety. Get your personalized Privacy Score based on your online habits and the apps you use. Climb the Leaderboard and compete with friends to see who has the strongest privacy shield. Understanding your data risk has never been this motivating!

Stay Informed and Ahead of the Threats

Our new Content Hub is your one-stop shop for the latest in privacy and cybersecurity.

Expert Insights: Stream top podcasts and read newsletters from leading security experts.
Daily Briefings: Get your daily dose of privacy news, curated just for you.
Smart Alerts: We cross-reference your apps with breaking news. If an app you use is in the headlines for the wrong reasons, you’ll be the first to know.

Your Personal Privacy Toolkit

ProSe is packed with powerful features to put you in control:

AI-Powered Policy Analysis: We read the fine print so you don’t have to. Our enhanced analysis now includes Red Flags for risky clauses and a clear grading system.
Educational Chatbot: Have a question about a privacy policy? Our friendly chatbot is here to help you understand your risks and how to mitigate them.
Digital Policy Archive: Keep a searchable record of every privacy policy you accept.
App Permission Manager: Easily review and manage the permissions for all your installed apps. Does that photo editor really need access to your contacts?
Customizable Privacy Profiles: Choose from our predefined profiles (Guarded, Vigilant, or Laid-back) or create your own to match your comfort level.

In the digital world, your data is your currency. Spend it wisely. Download ProSe today and turn yourself from a passive user into a privacy pro. Your digital life is worth protecting
